thread:
maria: Heads-up — GCP A100 pricing in asia-east1 jumped ~22% this cycle, showed up in last invoice. That bumps per-token infra unit cost on low-latency endpoints pretty noticeably. cc @sam @jon

sam: Ugh. Do we have quick back-of-envelope impact on RU per-1k tokens? (want a sense whether this is noise or needs packaging changes)

maria: Quick numbers:```
baseline infra unit cost (us-west1): $0.012 / 1k tokens
asia-east1 new (weighted): $0.0146 / 1k tokens  # ~21.7% increase
net impact after batching optimizations: +12% per-1k tokens for chat endpoints
```

jon: If that math holds, margin on our lowest-priced PLG tier goes from ~48% -> ~39% (rough ballpark) when you include storage and SRE overhead. That’s material.

nina: Important: we have ~35 enterprise seats in APAC with latency SLAs — we can't route them away from asia-east1. For PLG, maybe we can nudge region preference default.

sam: Two levers: 1) short term: pass-through surcharge for APAC-backed requests (ugly but preserves margins) 2) medium: update packaging for PLG (e.g., add region premium, or minimum committed tokens) 3) infra: shift more batch/quantized inference to cheaper zones where possible. Tradeoffs: revenue friction vs. engineering work.

maria: Also saw that committed reserved pricing for A100 in asia has a new commitment discount change if we sign 12mo reserved capacity — could be cheaper but requires forecast. I ran a quick commit sensitivity:```
scenarios = [
  "no commit": baseline (current on-demand rates)
  "6mo commit": ~8% reduction in unit cost
  "12mo commit + sustained use": ~15% reduction vs on-demand
]
breakeven: if APAC sustained throughput >= ~120k tokens/min for 12mo, commit pays off
```

jon: That breakeven seems reachable if we convert some burst traffic to reserved capacity and move latency-tolerant workloads. But risk: forecasting error + we lock cash.

nina: For enterprise customers with SLAs, can we offer a region premium line item (transparent) instead of blanket price change? They accept region add-ons for private capacity today.

sam: I propose hybrid: immediately implement a temporary APAC surcharge on new PLG usage (small percent, communicated as "regional infrastructure fee") + finance and infra produce a commit model for 12mo by EOD Friday. If commit forecast looks solid, we pursue 12mo reserve negotiation with cloud.

maria: I'll pull hourly utilization by region and map latency-critical flows. Also will flag which endpoints are eligible for routing changes (embedding vs chat vs fine-tuned).

cost-bot: automated alert — monthly forecast variance: asia-east1 compute spend +23% vs forecast; projected incremental cost this month: $42,300. CSV uploaded: //internal.finance/reports/asia_gcp_delta_Mar.csv

jon: Another packaging angle: tighten the free/low-tier token caps for APAC users or reduce credits to new signups in that region. Could reduce churn risk if we message as temporary.

nina: Legal note: check existing contracts for price-change clauses for enterprise customers in APAC before we send any surcharge notices.

sam: Action items: 1) maria -> region-utilization and endpoints eligible for routing (due Thu) 2) finance (jon) -> commit sensitivity model (6/12mo) with cashflow + breakeven (due Fri) 3) product (nina) -> draft customer comms & check contracts (due Thu EOD) 4) infra (sam) -> feasibility of moving non-latency-critical traffic to cheaper zones (sync Wed)

maria: 👍 will start. If anyone wants the quick calc sheet DM me, I put a sanitized copy in #finance-ops.

jon: Also flagging long-term: if cloud volatility in APAC becomes persistent we should add a regional-cost-index to pricing so changes are less ad-hoc.

nina: +1 — prefer automated, transparent uplift instead of surprise surcharges.

sam: Agreed. For now we need a surgical short-term fix. I'll schedule the infra sync for Wed 10am PT.

maria: Thanks team. Adding :eyes: reaction on the commit negotiation thread once I have utilization numbers.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from sam, :eyes: from jon)
